narrationTexts: I'll run the suite and filter to just the failure summary instead of the full wall of text.

Found it: `orderTotal` computes tax on the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted amount, contradicting its own doc comment ("tax what's actually owed... discount has to come off the base before the rate is applied").
finalText:
All 625 tests pass now.

The bug was in `orderTotal` (src/pricing.js): it computed tax on the original `cents` instead of on the discounted amount, contradicting its own doc comment that tax should apply to what the customer actually pays. Fixed by taxing `discounted` instead of `cents`. Only order-total cases with both a nonzero discount and nonzero tax exposed it, which is why 622/625 cases were passing.
